stem: Solve \(x + y = 14\) and \(x - y = 2\).
solution:
By adding both the equations we get an equation in one variable.
\(x + y = 14\) .........I
\(x - y = 2\) .........II
Adding I and II : \(2x + 0 = 16\)
\(\therefore 2x = 16\)
\(\therefore x = 8\)
Substituting \(x = 8\) in the equation (I) :
\(x + y = 14\)
\(\therefore 8 + y = 14\)
\(\therefore y = 6\)
Here \((8, 6)\) is the solution of the first equation. Let us check whether it satisfies the second equation also.
\(x - y = 8 - 6 = 2\) is true.
\(\therefore (8, 6)\) is the solution for both the equations.
Hence \((8, 6)\) is the solution of the simultaneous equations \(x + y = 14\) and \(x - y = 2\).

stem: Sum of the ages of mother and son is 45 years. If son's age is subtracted from twice of mother's age then we get answer 54. Find the ages of mother and son.
solution:
Let the mother's today's age be \(x\) years and son's today's age be \(y\) years.
From the first condition \(x + y = 45\) .........I
From the second condition \(2x - y = 54\) .........II
Adding equations (I) and (II) : \(3x + 0 = 99\)
\(\therefore 3x = 99\)
\(\therefore x = 33\)
Substituting \(x = 33\) in equation (I) : \(33 + y = 45\)
\(\therefore y = 45 - 33\)
\(\therefore y = 12\)
Verify that \(x = 33\) and \(y = 12\) is the solution of the second equation.
Today's age of mother \(= 33\) years and today's age of son \(= 12\) years.

stem: Solve the following equations : \(3x + y = 5\) and \(2x + 3y = 1\).
solution:
\(3x + y = 5\) ........... (I)
\(2x + 3y = 1\) ........(II)
To eliminate one of the variables, we observe that in both equations, not a single coefficient is an equal or opposite number. Hence we will make one of them equal.
Multiply both sides of the equation (I) by 3.
\(\therefore 3x \times 3 + 3 \times y = 5 \times 3\)
\(\therefore 9x + 3y = 15\) .......(III)
\(2x + 3y = 1\) .......(II)
Now subtracting eqn (II) from eqn (III) : \(7x = 14\)
\(\therefore x = 2\)
Substituting \(x = 2\) in one of the equations :
\(2x + 3y = 1\)
\(\therefore 2 \times 2 + 3y = 1\)
\(\therefore 4 + 3y = 1\)
\(\therefore 3y = -3\)
\(\therefore y = -1\)
Verify that \((2, -1)\) satisfies the second equation.

stem: Solve the following simultaneous equations : \(3x - 4y - 15 = 0\) and \(y + x + 2 = 0\).
solution:
Let us write the equations by shifting constant terms to RHS.
\(3x - 4y = 15\) ........(I)
\(x + y = -2\) .............(II)
To eliminate \(y\), multiply the second equation by 4 and add to equation (I).
\(3x - 4y = 15\)
\(4x + 4y = -8\)
Adding : \(7x = 7\)
\(\therefore x = 1\)
Substituting \(x = 1\) in the equation (II) :
\(x + y = -2\)
\(\therefore 1 + y = -2\)
\(\therefore y = -2 - 1\)
\(\therefore y = -3\)
\((1, -3)\) is the solution of the above equations. Verify that it satisfies equation (I) also.

\(8x + 3y = 11\) ................. (I)
\(3x - y = 2\) .......................(II)
In Equation (II), it is easy to express \(y\) in terms of \(x\).
\(3x - y = 2\)
\(3x - 2 = y\)
Substituting \(y = 3x - 2\) in equation (I).
\(8x + 3y = 11\)
\(\therefore 8x + 3(3x - 2) = 11\)
\(\therefore 8x + 9x - 6 = 11\)
\(\therefore 17x - 6 = 11\)
\(\therefore 17x = 11 + 6 = 17\)
\(\therefore x = 1\)
Now, substituting this value of \(x\) in the equation \(y = 3x - 2\).
\(y = 3 \times 1 - 2\)
\(\therefore y = 1\)
\(\therefore (1, 1)\) is the solution of the given equations.

\(3x - 4y = 16\) ..........(I)
\(2x - 3y = 10\) ............(II)
Writing \(x\) in terms of \(y\) from equation (I).
\(3x - 4y = 16\)
\(3x = 16 + 4y\)
\(x = \dfrac{16 + 4y}{3}\)
Substituting this value of \(x\) in equation (II) :
\(2x - 3y = 10\)
\(2\left(\dfrac{16 + 4y}{3}\right) - 3y = 10\)
\(\dfrac{32 + 8y}{3} - 3y = 10\)
\(\dfrac{32 + 8y - 9y}{3} = 10\)
\(32 + 8y - 9y = 30\)
\(32 - y = 30\)  \(\therefore y = 2\)
Now, substituting \(y = 2\) in equation (I) :
\(3x - 4y = 16\)
\(\therefore 3x - 4 \times 2 = 16\)
\(\therefore 3x - 8 = 16\)
\(\therefore 3x = 16 + 8\)
\(\therefore 3x = 24\)
\(\therefore x = 8\)
\(\therefore x = 8\) and \(y = 2\)
\(\therefore (8, 2)\) is the solution of the given equations.

stem: Sum of two numbers is 103. If greater number is divided by smaller number then the quotient is 2 and the remainder is 19. Then find the numbers.
solution:
Use proper variables for the given quantities. Also note the rule dividend = divisor \(\times\) quotient + remainder.
Let the greater number be \(x\) and the smaller number be \(y\).
Given information : Sum of the numbers \(= 103\)
\(x + y = 103\) is the first equation.
By dividing greater number by smaller number the quotient is 2 and remainder is 19.
\(x = 2 \times y + 19\) ...(dividend = divisor \(\times\) quotient + remainder)
\(x - 2y = 19\) is the second equation.
\(x + y = 103\) ................(I)
\(x - 2y = 19\) ................(II)
Subtracting eqn. (II) from eqn. (I) : \(0 + 3y = 84\)
\(\therefore y = 28\)
Substituting the value of \(y\) in equation \(x + y = 103\) :
\(\therefore x + 28 = 103\)
\(\therefore x = 103 - 28\)
\(\therefore x = 75\)
Given numbers are 75 and 28.

stem: Salil's age is 23 years more than half of the Sangram's age. Five years ago, the sum of their ages was 55 years. Find their present ages.
solution:
Let Salil's present age be \(x\) and Sangram's present age be \(y\).
Salil's age is 23 years more than half of the Sangram's age \(\therefore x = \dfrac{y}{2} + 23\)
Five years ago Salil's age \(= x - 5\). Five years ago Sangram's age \(= y - 5\).
The sum of their ages five years ago \(= 55\)
\((x - 5) + (y - 5) = 55\)
Finding the solution by solving equations :
\(2x = y + 46\), i.e. \(2x - y = 46\) .............(I)
\((x - 5) + (y - 5) = 55\), i.e. \(x + y = 65\) ............(II)
Adding equation (I) and (II) : \(3x = 111\)
\(\therefore x = 37\)
Substituting \(x = 37\) in equation (II) :
\(x + y = 65\)
\(\therefore 37 + y = 65\)
\(\therefore y = 65 - 37\)
\(\therefore y = 28\)
Salil's present age is 37 years and Sangram's present age is 28 years.

stem: A two digit number is 4 times the sum of its digits. If we interchange the digits, the number obtained is 9 less than 4 times the original number. Then find the number.
solution:
Let the units place digit in the original number be \(x\), and the tens place be \(y\).

| | Digit in tens place | Digit in units place | Number | Sum of the digits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| For original number | \(y\) | \(x\) | \(10y + x\) | \(y + x\) |
| Number obtained by interchanging the digits | \(x\) | \(y\) | \(10x + y\) | \(x + y\) |

From first condition, \(10y + x = 4(y + x)\)
\(\therefore 10y + x = 4y + 4x\)
\(\therefore x - 4x + 10y - 4y = 0\)
\(\therefore -3x + 6y = 0\)  \(\therefore -3x = -6y\)  \(\therefore x = 2y\) .....(I)
From second condition, \(10x + y = 2(10y + x) - 9\)
\(10x + y = 20y + 2x - 9\)
\(10x - 2x + y - 20y = -9\)
\(8x - 19y = -9\) ............(II)
Substituting \(x = 2y\) in equation (II) : \(16y - 19y = -9\)
\(\therefore -3y = -9\)
\(\therefore y = 3\)
Substituting \(y = 3\) in equation (I) : \(x - 2y = 0\)
\(x - 2 \times 3 = 0\)  \(\therefore x - 6 = 0\)  \(\therefore x = 6\)
Original two digit number : \(10y + x = 10 \times 3 + 6 = 36\)

stem: The population of a certain town was 50,000. In a year, male population was increased by 5% and female population was increased by 3%. Now the population became 52020. Then what was the number of males and females in the previous year?
solution:
Let the number of males in previous year be \(x\), number of females be \(y\).
By first condition \(x + y = 50000\) .......(I)
Male population increased by 5% \(\therefore\) number of males \(= \dfrac{105}{100}x\)
Female population increased by 3% \(\therefore\) number of females \(= \dfrac{103}{100}y\)
From second condition \(\dfrac{105}{100}x + \dfrac{103}{100}y = 52020\)
\(105x + 103y = 5202000\) .......(II)
Multiplying equation (I) by 103 : \(103x + 103y = 5150000\) ........(III)
Subtracting equation (III) from equation (II) :
\(2x = 5202000 - 5150000\)
\(2x = 52000\)
\(\therefore\) number of males \(= x = 26000\)  \(\therefore\) number of females \(= y = 50000 - 26000 = 24000\)

stem: 'When 5 is subtracted from length and breadth of the rectangle, the perimeter becomes 26.' What is the mathematical form of the statement ?
_why: With length x and breadth y, the reduced perimeter is 2[(x-5)+(y-5)] = 26, so (x-5)+(y-5) = 13, giving x + y - 10 = 13 and hence x + y = 23.
